result.explanation: libfoo.so CodeCheck.bar(byte[]) strncmps the input against the .rodata string 'Thanks for all the fish' (23 bytes), but only when the .bss gate byte at file offset 0x400c == 1 — a flag the native init() sets after its fork/ptrace anti-debug passes. Under instrumentation the anti-debug breaks (onCreate throws 'Bad file descriptor'), so the bypass stubs MainActivity.init() and writes the gate byte directly; bar() then returns true for the secret and false otherwise.
